0.title: Welcome to AMVerge
0.body: Let's take a quick lap around AMVerge so you know where every page lives, how imports and previews work, and where to unlock optional AI features.

1.title: 1. Library
1.body: Library is your home workspace. Import episodes or video files here to split them into scenes, hover to preview every cut, and export the clips you select straight to your editor.

2.title: 2. Scenepacks
2.body: Scenepacks lets you group favorite clips from any episode into custom collections by character, mood, etc. You can turn it on anytime in Settings › Features.

3.title: 3. Scene Scout
3.body: Scene Scout searches across your episodes and clips from a plain-English description (or finds clips that flow from a clip you already have). Enable and download it anytime in Settings › Features.

4.title: 4. Community Events
4.body: Events lists active AMV contests and Hour Challenges from the community. Browse active brackets, join their Discord servers, or sign in with Discord to host your own.

5.title: 5. Open the Menu
5.body: Click the ☰ menu button right next to the AMVerge logo to open Quick Navigation, or press Next to jump straight in.

6.title: 6. Open Settings
6.body: Click Settings here to configure how AMVerge detects cuts, plays previews, and installs optional features.

7.title: 7. Scene Detection Methods
7.body:
Choose how imports find cuts:
• Keyframe Detection cuts instantly on video keyframes and works on any PC with no GPU.
• AI Scene Detection checks every frame with TransNetV2 for exact shot changes (slower without a GPU; install anytime).

8.title: 8. Preview Methods
8.body:
Choose how the grid plays clips when you hover:
• Video Files cuts real video clips per scene so previews match your export.
• WebP Files builds lightweight animated previews for smoother scrolling and lower memory usage (exports still cut from full quality).

9.title: 9. Features & Downloads
9.body: In Features you can switch on and download optional tools whenever you want them, including Scene Scout, AI Scene Detection, Scenepacks, Upscaling, and Depth Maps.

10.title: 10. All Set
10.body: That's about it for the tutorial! If you need this guide again, click the ? help button in the top toolbar. Enjoy!
